description: The browser vendors shipped minified by tools/minify-vendor.mjs: whitespace and local bindings, including function and class names. Terser compression is off, export and property names are untouched, comments carrying a licence or copyright stay; the upstream file stays the source. A vendor with a standIn has it applied to the upstream text first (tools/minify-vendor.mjs STAND_INS). Each vendor pins the upstream and derived bytes; a different upstream, Terser, option or stand-in is refused until equivalence is measured and the pair is pinned again. The retained agent-door-keeps-whole-characters row owns Acorn parsing and structure; select-all-delete-recovery owns the browser's Turndown paste-to-source path. Every vendor's full notice is also in agent/vendor/NOTICE.txt and the application's licences.

standIn.what: The RegExp validator gives way to the engine the structure Worker runs on: a regexp literal is valid iff new RegExp(pattern, flags) accepts it, or -- when the engine refuses -- iff it accepts the pattern with every \p{..}/\P{..} value Acorn's own tables know written as one every engine knows; refused at the pattern's start with the engine's message. Acorn's Unicode property and script tables and its identifier tables stay: the grammar is the engine's, the Unicode data is Acorn's (tasks #311 and #328).
